title: Dualities in Multiparameter Persistence
summary: In the theory of persistent homology, a well known duality relates the barcodes of the absolute homology and relative cohomology of a one-parameter simplicial filtration. Motivated by the problem of computing free presentations of the (co)homology of multiparameter Rips filtrations, we give a multiparameter generalization of this duality.
